text:
## Audit & Monitoring  
**Internal Audit:**
- Annual testing of AML procedures
- Sample file review (KYC, EDD, SAR decisions)
- Control testing
- AML system validation  
**Regulatory Audit:**
- FCA/PRA periodic AML examinations
- Thematic reviews
- Consent orders (if violations found)  
**Performance Metrics:**
| Metric | Target |
|--------|--------|
| AML screening completion rate | 100% |
| SAR filing accuracy | 100% |
| SAR filing timeliness (within 30 days) | 95%+ |
| High-risk customer EDD completion | 100% |
| Staff training completion | 100% annual |

raw_entities.description: The overarching AML policy framework governing internal audit procedures, regulatory examinations, and performance metrics for AML screening, SAR filing, and customer due diligence. The policy establishes mandatory testing, monitoring, and compliance targets across all AML operations.

raw_entities.name: Annual AML Procedures Testing
raw_entities.description: Mandatory annual testing of all AML procedures as part of the internal audit function. This provision ensures ongoing validation and effectiveness of AML controls.

raw_entities.description: Requirement to conduct sample file reviews covering KYC, Enhanced Due Diligence, and SAR decisions as part of internal audit procedures. This provision ensures quality and compliance of customer due diligence documentation.

raw_entities.description: Mandatory testing of AML controls to verify their operational effectiveness and compliance with policy requirements.

raw_entities.name: AML System Validation
raw_entities.description: Requirement to validate AML systems as part of internal audit procedures to ensure technical controls are functioning correctly.

raw_entities.description: Requirement to participate in thematic reviews conducted by regulatory authorities to assess specific AML compliance areas.

raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement to achieve 100% completion rate for AML screening across all applicable transactions and customers.

raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement to maintain 100% accuracy in Suspicious Activity Report filings to regulatory authorities.

raw_entities.description: Requirement to file Suspicious Activity Reports within 30 days, with a target compliance rate of 95% or higher.

raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement to complete Enhanced Due Diligence for all high-risk customers with a 100% completion target.

raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement for all staff to complete AML training annually, with a 100% completion target.
